verdict_text:
YES

The script builds the keep index as blocks 0..4 and 6..15 of width 128, which is exactly rows/columns 0..639 and 768..2047 in order. It applies it on axis 0 for q, k and v and on axis 1 for o_proj, matching the required shapes, leaves all other tensors and names untouched, asserts the five required checks before writing, and writes a single file at `out/T2/model.safetensors`.
